modmenu.descriptionTranslation.pas: Now armor stands be lookin' like players... but don't forget to rename 'em, matey!

commands.pas.skin_not_found: Can't find the booty for that skin
pas.buttons.configurator.tooltip: Open the Player Armor Stand riggin' to manage the skin and its trinkets
pas.download_failed: Failed to haul in the skin for %s
pas.config.try_apply_from_server_player: Try to Borrow Skin from a Server Player
pas.menu.name: Armor Stand Riggin'
pas.menu.tab.cape.name: Cape Name / ID
pas.menu.tab.cape.name.tooltip: To haul a cape from NameMC, ye must give its cape ID. Fer example, in "https://namemc.com/cape/cb5dd34bee340182" the ID be "cb5dd34bee340182".
pas.menu.tab.skin.name: Name / ID
pas.menu.tab.skin.name.tooltip: To haul a skin from Mojang's servers, enter the player's name. Fer NameMC, copy the skin ID from its port (fer example, in "https://namemc.com/skin/4da4ce379e8b0d00" the skin ID be "4da4ce379e8b0d00") and drop it in the field below. Only AFTER choosin' the skin port and Name / ID should ye press Enter or the button to starboard of the field.
pas.menu.tab.cape.label: Show Cape
pas.menu.tab.overlay.name: Overlay Texture
pas.menu.tab.overlay.name.tooltip: In the field below, give any texture name found in assets/minecraft/textures/blocks (fer example, stone)
pas.menu.tab.overlay.display_name.toolti: The name in the chest below be shown instead of the player's name. Press Enter to apply it.
pas.rp.3d_items_with_head.desc: Item model with a changin' head for the Player Armor Stands mod
pas.rp.3d_items_player_like.desc: Item model with a player's skin for the Player Armor Stands mod
pas.yacl_required.1: To rig this mod, ye need Yet Another Config Lib (YACL).
pas.yacl_required.2: Haul it in from Modrinth to continue, matey!
